violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.

raw_text:
PLAN "2-Week Hotel Room Maintenance Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "maintain hypertrophy during travel"

PHASES
  PHASE "Maintenance Phase" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body + Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..16 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Push + Shoulders":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 4m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Upper Pull Emphasis + Arms":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 6x2..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 35m "Lower Body + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..16 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          arnold_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x25..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Pull Density + Arms":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 5x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x25..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Lower Body + Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Full-Body Circuit Light":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 4m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x2..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
